rawFindings.title: Home helper no longer recognizes index.html as the home page
rawFindings.explanation: The new base-page check only treats an empty route path as home. Existing route contexts that use `index.html` for the root page now fall through to the pagination regex and return false, even though `index.html` is the site home.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the previous root-page condition, e.g. `if (!this.path || this.path === 'index.html') return true;`.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Calling `is.home` with `{path: 'index.html', config: {pagination_dir: 'page'}}` returns `false` instead of `true`.

rawFindings.title: Pagination home check now matches non-pagination child paths
rawFindings.explanation: The new pagination regex is only prefix-anchored. Any path beginning with `pagination_dir/<number>/` is classified as a home pagination page, even when it points to a nested file that is not the pagination index.
rawFindings.suggestion: Anchor the regex to the full pagination page path, e.g. `new RegExp('^' + escapeRegExp(paginationDir) + '\\/\\d+\\/(index\\.html)?$')`.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Calling `is.home` with `{path: 'page/2/archive.html', config: {pagination_dir: 'page'}}` returns `true` instead of `false`.
